messages:
sara: Starting deploy v2.3.1 -> canary. Plan: staggered swapback for feature flag 'model-route-v2'. Deploybot will ramp 5% -> 20% -> 50% unless we hit rollback triggers. Keeping v2.2.1 pinned as fallback. @oncall please watch latency + 5xx.
deploy-bot: deploy started: v2.3.1 -> canary cluster infra-canary-3. Applying flag 'model-route-v2' weight=5% for initial cohort. I will post updates.
praveen: Quick confirm on rollback thresholds: if 5xx > 0.5% in any 3m window OR p95 latency increases by >200ms, we drain back to pinned v2.2.1 and set flag to 0%. Ack?
henry: Ack. Suggest ramp timing: 5% (3m observe) -> 20% (4m) -> 50% (10m). If any anomaly, pause and hold for 5m; sample traces 100% for these cohorts.
maria: seeing a small spike after first step (5%). 5xx ~0.42% in last 60s and p95 +60ms. Recommend HOLD and don't advance to 20% yet.
deploy-bot: flag update: model-route-v2 weight=5% applied by deploy-bot. Health snapshot: p95=320ms (+60ms), 5xx=0.42% :eyes:
sara: Holding. Do not advance. praveen, can you pin v2.2.1 traffic to 100% for eu-west-1 if this persists?
praveen: Pin command: `./ops pin-version --service model-router --version v2.2.1 --region eu-west-1` — running now.
praveen: Pin applied. Also prepped rollback helper: `./ops ff set model-route-v2 0 --reason "swapback hold"` (ready to execute).
maria: after pin, 5xx dropped to 0.08%. p95 back to baseline. :thumbsup:
henry: Given recovery, recommend resuming but with a smaller next step: 10% and a longer observe window (10m) before the 25% step.
sara: Agreed. deploy-bot, apply 10% for eu-west-1 only.
deploy-bot: flag update: model-route-v2 weight=10% for eu-west-1. Monitoring: p95=310ms, 5xx=0.09%.
maria: looks stable at 10m, no anomalies. ready to proceed to 25%.
henry: Hold a sec — I'll add a short note to the release notes to call out the swapback thresholds and the rollback command.
henry: Release notes draft: "v2.3.1 - rolling canary for model-route-v2. Ramp plan: 5 -> 10 -> 25 -> 50. Rollback triggers: 5xx > 0.5% OR p95 +200ms. Pin fallback: v2.2.1. Rollback command: ./ops ff set model-route-v2 0". Link: https://go/release/notes/v2.3.1
sara: Thanks — proceeding to 25% now.
deploy-bot: flag update: model-route-v2 weight=25% global. Health: p95=305ms, 5xx=0.07%. Completed at 6758493060.
praveen: Infra LGTM. I'll schedule gradual unpin after 24h soak; keeping v2.2.1 pinned as immediate backup for now.
maria: test traffic looks good. :party_parrot:
sara: Closing this thread — moving notes into the release doc. If any late regressions, escalate in #eng-oncall. Thanks everyone :rocket:
